remarks: Welcome to 37 Seaview Ave in the attractive East Norwalk! EVERYTHING IS NEW! Water views of the L.I. Sound won't disappoint. Just a hop, skip and a jump from the L.I Sound/Veterans Park (Oyster Festival), SONO, many shops/restaurants & MORE! Commuter friendly also! Just minutes from East Norwalk/South Norwalk Train Stations, I95 (Exit 16), Rt7 & MORE! This second floor unit includes 1 spacious bedroom, 1 full bathroom, living room & EIK + garage parking. Hardwood floors throughout, brand new kitchen/bathroom, plenty of closet/cabinet storage + many windows for natural light make you feel right at home. Natural Gas for heat, hot water & cooking help keep utilities cost LOW! Tenants must have good credit, proof of income & references. Plenty of parking on Seaview Ave or Betts Place. Pets are case by case basis/ No smoking allowed.
